literal.prompt: В какой камере сердца расположен синоатриальный узел?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The complete19.2 SA-node paragraph L58 explicitly places it in superior/posterior right-atrial walls near the superior vena cava orifice, and L59-L64 describes atrial impulse spread. Thus right atrium uniquely answers the chamber-location question; the left atrium and either ventricle are not alternate locations of the normal SA node.19.1 L60 defines the four chamber categories, and actual options give all four at identical anatomical/detail level. «В камере» uses the usual regional anatomy sense, clarified by the note’s wall location, not a claim that the node floats within the blood cavity.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Both sentences are directly grounded in the full19.2 L58 SA-node paragraph: superior/posterior right-atrial location near SVC opening and establishment of normal cardiac rhythm. The first sentence gives precise within-chamber geography and the second explicitly gives the right atrium as answer. This does not infer location from rhythm alone or claim other conducting cells cannot pace under abnormal circumstances; the complete L94-L97/L118-L143 qualifications were read. Two clear sentences, no clinical-treatment assertion.

absoluteLevel.ground: MEDIUM: a player familiar with heart conduction/basic cardiovascular anatomy can locate the named SA node in the right atrium. Broad knowledge that the heart has four chambers or that a node sets rhythm is insufficient by itself; every alternative is a genuine chamber and the prompt gives no right/left/atrium lexical clue. It requires thematic anatomical familiarity rather than universal adult recall, while not requiring exact wall coordinates, channel potentials, timing or professional ECG interpretation (those are not asked). No inherited frozen-label/author judgment used.

correctNoteExtraFact.fact: The node lies in the upper/posterior right-atrial wall near the superior vena cava orifice.
correctNoteExtraFact.ground: The asked value is only the chamber. Wall region and a specific nearby vessel opening add precise own-right-atrium/node-location details, directly present in19.2 L58 and valid even though repeated in explanation.
